name: skaldkeep
description: Skills for working with a Skaldkeep campaign chronicle over its MCP server: connect, use the tools, process sessions, transcribe locally, write recap songs and clean up facets.

interface.shortDescription: Campaign chronicle skills for TTRPG groups
interface.longDescription: Turn session transcripts into staged Skaldkeep campaign documents, transcribe recordings with AssemblyAI, write recap songs and keep filter values tidy. The MCP server itself is configured in config.toml with bearer_token_env_var = "SKALDKEEP_TOKEN" (see the skaldkeep-connect skill).
defaultPrompt: Process the latest session transcript in Skaldkeep.
